description: A 3HP sine oscillator with one audio output and an end-of-cycle pulse.

params.text: Sets the pitch in volts, -3 to +3; 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz.
Shifts the pitch by up to half an octave either way.

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to FREQ; the number of channels patched here sets the oscillator's polyphony.
Shifts the pitch by a fifth of an octave per volt, added to FINE.
A rising edge restarts the waveform from the beginning of its cycle.

outputs.text: A 10V pulse one sample long each time the waveform reaches the end of a cycle.

notes: The pitch from the two knobs and the two pitch inputs together is limited to three and a half octaves either side of C4.

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±3.5V.
